# Omya

> > Global producer of industrial minerals, calcium carbonate, specialty materials, and polymer distribution solutions serving diverse industries worldwide.

Omya is a leading minerals-based specialty chemicals company with operations across North America, Central America, South America, and globally. The company processes calcium carbonate, dolomite, and perlite for applications in agriculture, industrial manufacturing, and specialty materials, with regional facilities including Omya Kansas for limestone processing and agricultural products.

## Key Topics

- Calcium carbonate
- Industrial minerals
- Specialty materials
- Polymer distribution
- Mineral processing
- Sustainability
- Dolomite
- Perlite
- Agriculture products
- Limestone production
- Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
- Granulated products
- Turf and ornamental
- Global manufacturing
- Innovation
